def: Under the EU AI Act, an AI system serving as a safety component of a regulated product (Annex I) or used in a listed sensitive area such as hiring or credit (Annex III).
practice: Carries the heaviest obligations, such as risk management, documentation, human oversight and conformity assessment, which after the AI Omnibus apply from 2 December 2027 (Annex III) and 2 August 2028 (Annex I), as of November 2026.
